entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.33 — Multi-Company GUID lock (crash-fix)
entries.desc: CRITICAL hotfix over v9.8.32. Krishna Sales Corp reported the new agent hanging and crashing Tally on a PC with multiple books loaded. Root cause: our GUID-lookup XML used `ISINITIALIZE="Yes"` on the Company collection AND wrapped the call in `SVCURRENTCOMPANY` — Tally spent every quick-sync tick rebuilding its cache and eventually froze. v9.8.33 rewrites the lookup to the exact shape as v9.8.31's proven-safe `list_of_companies` (`ISMODIFY="No"`, no SVCURRENTCOMPANY, only NAME + GUID fetches) and caches the result per-session so Tally is queried at most ONCE per company per launch. Backend was also softened — missing GUID on a bound sync now soft-accepts with a warning (older Tally builds no longer stranded); hard block still fires on GUID MISMATCH (the only real corruption vector). All v9.8.32 installs must upgrade — the auto-update banner will trigger on next agent launch. Ships as `FlowraTallyAgent_v9.8.33.exe`.

entries.title: Forgot Password — Business Admin only, temporary password by email
entries.desc: Login page now has a 'Forgot password?' link. Click → modal shows the disclaimer *'Reset password facility only for Business Admin'* and asks for the admin's email. Backend `/api/auth/forgot-password` looks up the user, strictly requires `role == "admin"`, and on match emails a fresh 12-char random password (mixed case + digit + symbol, no confusable chars). Employees, dispatch, salesman and super-admin get the same generic success response so no address can be enumerated. Rate-limited (3/IP/hr, 1/email/15min) via `password_reset_attempts` collection. `must_change_password` flag is set on the user; the very next login lands on a force-change screen that gates all app access until they pick a new password (min 8 chars, upper+lower+digit, != temp). `/auth/change-password` `$unset`s the flag.

entries.title: WhatsApp Share on Salesman Orders + Instant Admin Email + 8pm Daily Digest
entries.desc: Every order row in the Salesman → My Orders screen (and Admin's Orders queue) gets a green WhatsApp button. On mobile the browser's Web Share API Level 2 attaches the ACTUAL PDF file (WhatsApp receives it as a document); on desktop / older browsers it opens `wa.me` pre-filled with an absolute PDF link (ingress-scheme aware — `X-Forwarded-Proto` / `X-Forwarded-Host`). Recipient taps the link → the PDF renders inline, no login. On order submit useradmin gets an instant email with the PDF attached. And every day at 8:00 PM IST a per-tenant Emergent cron fires `/api/cron/daily-order-digest` which emails useradmin a full day summary (by-salesman totals + every order row + customer count). Cron endpoint validates `WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET` via constant-time compare and enqueues the fan-out asynchronously so it acks 2xx in <200 ms.

entries.title: Inventory Qty Reconciler — extended to Salesman order screens
entries.desc: The iter-165 voucher-derived closing-stock reconciler is now wired into `/salesman-orders/catalog` and `_build_inventory_lookup` (repeat + related-items). The salesman now sees exactly the same closing values as the admin's Inventory tab — no more agent-inflated stock over-promises during order placement. FY-scoped to the current FY for accuracy. Tally tenants untouched (Tally's closing_qty is already accurate, so the `agent > derived` guard leaves it alone — verified live: 5 / 202 items adjusted on the ASA-AUTOTECH Tally tenant vs 838 / 13,682 on the Busy busydemo tenant).

entries.title: Inventory Qty Reconciler — trusts voucher movement over agent's D-column heuristic
entries.desc: Busy Agent <= v1.6.1 reads closing_qty from `max(abs(D11..D50))` in Folio1 — those are monthly period-tallies on Busy 21, so an item that received 28 units in one month and 16 in another reports 44 even when Busy Stock Status shows 16. Same class inflates FA00725 from 0 → 2000. New server-side reconciler recomputes `closing = opening + Σ purchases − Σ sales` for the FY and overrides only when the agent's value is clearly inflated (`derived >= 0` AND `agent > derived`). Wired into Dashboard tile, Inventory list, Movement Analysis, PDF export, Pivot & Below-Cost endpoints. Live on busydemo: 838/13,682 items corrected, 0 negative quantities. Items with **no voucher activity** (FA00725 class) still need the upcoming Agent v1.6.2 D-column fix — server-side alone can't reconcile against zero data.

entries.title: SuperAdmin — Feature Toggle Save Was Silently Overwritten
entries.desc: SuperAdmin → Admin Management → Edit → un-tick Sales/CRM/Inventory → Save behaved as a no-op. The frontend was sending `plan.features` (the plan's default feature set) instead of `editAdmin.features` (the SuperAdmin's edited selection), so the backend faithfully wrote the untouched full list back. Fixed in both `saveEditAdmin` and `convertProspect`. Verified live on the pod: a 12-feature admin trimmed to 4 features persists correctly; user's nav sidebar hides Sales/CRM/Inventory tabs, and direct URLs to those pages are 404-guarded. Bug reported by amitbajaj.india@gmail.com class of tenants.

entries.title: Salesman screens now show Product Category + ABC pill
entries.desc: Admin's Salesman → Item-wise Sales table and every New-Order row (Repeat, Suggestions, Browse Catalog) now surface Busy's product category alongside the A/B/C/D pill exactly as it appears on the Inventory tab. Backend enrichment on `/salesman-orders/catalog`, `_build_inventory_lookup`, `/salesman-orders/my-stats`, `/salesman/performance-detailed`. Catalog dedupes per-FY snapshots so a SKU never renders twice with contradictory stock qty. Catalog limit raised 2000 → 20000 so large books aren't alphabetically truncated.

entries.title: Busy Agent v1.6.1 — Stock-Group Name Resolution
entries.desc: Master1 rows returned `Code` as an int on licensed Busy 21, so downstream `str(code)` lookups missed every stock-group name — Inventory + Salesman screens showed `Code:23134` in the Category column. v1.6.1 normalises the key to string on insert. Rebuild `.exe` via `build.bat` to distribute; once salesmen re-sync, all category chips light up with real names.

entries.title: Busy CRM — Customer Group-Hierarchy Fix (BSA class of bug)
entries.desc: Books nesting debtors under user-created sub-groups (e.g. 'SUNDRY DEBTORS - JBP') were losing every party at sync time — only debtors directly under Busy's built-in root (code 116) landed in Mongo. Two-layer fix: (a) Busy Agent v1.6.0 walks the ParentGrp chain until it hits a built-in root, cycle-safe; (b) server-side safety-net synthesizes customer rows from sale-party names when the synced list is suspiciously small (< 20% of distinct sale parties). CRM Outstanding + Payment Behavior + Salesman → Map Customers dropdown all recover automatically — no agent rebuild strictly required for the UI to light back up. Rebuilding v1.6.0 later restores full address/GST/contact enrichment.

entries.title: Busy Inventory & Value Doubling — Root Cause
entries.desc: Every recurring Busy mismatch (Dashboard, Inventory list, Movement Analysis, PDF export, CA Corner) traced to one bug: iter-158's dedupe was SUMMING closing quantities across per-FY snapshots. Busy re-syncs the same physical SKU into every FY database file — an item with 5 kg on 31-Mar-26 and 10 kg on 11-Sep-26 became 15 kg. Fix: dedupe now picks the row for the requested FY (or latest FY if no filter). Expected on BSA production: 1143 items / ₹1.11 Cr → ~659 items / ~₹50 L (matches Busy Stock Status CSV exactly).

entries.title: Inventory Demand Forecast — Analytics tab
entries.desc: New admin-only tab with a KPI band, consolidated buy list, month × SKU heatmap, top-customer cohort projections, and CSV export. Per-SKU model auto-selects between Holt-Winters (A-class steady sellers), SES (B-class), Croston + SBA (C-class intermittent) and cohort median (new SKUs). Confidence bands, reorder-point + safety-stock, optional festival/monsoon lens and what-if growth-% slider. Uses ALL synced FYs — analysed 13,696 NAV SKUs in ~8 seconds.

entries.title: Setup Page — Per-Agent Release Manifest
entries.desc: Busy tenants now see the correct Busy Sync Agent version chip (v1.5.7) and download link. Tally tenants stay on v9.8.28. Backend routes each tenant to its own release manifest via `?source=busy|tally`. Removed the ODBC/OLE-DB technical blurbs from customer-facing text.

entries.title: ERP Label Dynamic Everywhere
entries.desc: The 'Set in Tally' / 'Tally ✓' / 'from Tally*' labels now dynamically read 'Tally' or 'Busy' based on the caller's cached agent source. Dashboard, Inventory, CRM, Sync History, Setup — all switch together.

entries.title: Dashboard Inventory Count — 10K → Real Count
entries.desc: Dashboard inventory tile was capped at 10,000 by a `to_list(10000)` truncation. Swapped to `count_documents()` — exact count, faster, matches the Inventory menu.

entries.title: Customer Lifecycle — 'All Lost' Bug
entries.desc: Busy voucher_date carries a time suffix (`2025-04-01 00:00:00`) which broke the lifecycle date parser and bucketed every customer as LOST. Fixed by normalising to the first 10 chars.

entries.title: SPIP Analysis Count Consistency
entries.desc: SPIP was inflating the SKU total by union-ing sales-voucher item keys with inventory master. Now analyses ONLY the tenant's inventory master — count matches the Inventory menu exactly.

entries.title: Cross-Tenant Excel Export Leak Sealed
entries.desc: `/api/analytics/sales-frequency/export` was running an empty query — any authenticated caller would download every tenant's sales as XLSX. Scoped to the caller's tenant + company via `get_tenant_context`.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.7 — Correct Invoice Line Math
entries.desc: Sales-voucher line `amount` now = qty × rate (was reading D6 which turned out to be a duplicate of rate, so `avg sale price` analytics collapsed to 1/qty of reality). `discount` derived from MRP − rate. External customer PO/reference read from Tran1.RefNoAlpha separately from the printed VchNo. Every voucher, inventory, customer and creditor row now carries an `fy` tag so CA-Corner FY selectors work.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.6 — Data Parity
entries.desc: Inventory `delete_many`-per-chunk backend bug fixed (was wiping ~24K items down to 182 on every sync). P&L + all_ledgers keys expanded to include FY so both FYs coexist. `net_profit_loss` emitted correctly. `opening_quantity/rate/value` sourced from Folio1. Sale/cost price fallback ladder for SKUs without transactions.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.5 — Reader Pool
entries.desc: Each `.bds` file now opens once per sync tick instead of ~14 times. Cuts full-sync CPU roughly in half on large NAV-sized databases and eliminates the AccessParser reopen jank in logs.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.4 — Real Company Name + Retry
entries.desc: Extracts the actual company display name (e.g. `NAVDURGA AUTO SPARES JABALPUR`) from Busy master DB instead of falling back to the folder id `COMP0002`. Folder-keyed FLOWRA mapping auto-migrates legacy rows in-place. 3-tier retry backoff (5s/30s/60s) on 502/503/404 with loud `[SYNC-LOST]` dead-letter logs — no more silent data drops on network hiccups.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.3 — Real VchType Mapping
entries.desc: Licensed Busy 21 uses different voucher-type numbers than Busy Demo. Fixed: Purchase=2, Receipt=14, Payment=16 (new category), Contra=19, Journal=4, Debit Note=12, Credit Note=10 (folds Rate-Diff 17 and Discount 18), Sundry Journal=3 (new category). Previously purchase/contra/journal/debit-note came in as zero — now shows all 467 purchases, 568 contras, 431 payments, 1,446 receipts and more.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.2 — Multi-FY + Real Schema Fix
entries.desc: Daemon now syncs ALL FYs from the selected start_FY onwards on every tick. Sales invoices carry real item names, quantities, GST %, MRP, discounts, warehouse and the Google Drive PDF link Busy stores. Inventory shows human-readable names, HSN, cost + sale price.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.1 — Licensed Busy 21 Fully Supported
entries.desc: Root-cause fix for the '-1905 Not a valid password' + 'Temporary Ace DSN' errors on licensed Busy 21. Added a pure-Python JET4 reader that bypasses the Windows Access driver entirely — zero password prompts, zero registry writes.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.5.0 — Enriched Customer Sync
entries.desc: Direct-ODBC extract now pulls party group hierarchy, WhatsApp-normalized mobile, email, GST/PAN, split address, station, city, state, price category, salesman link and closing balance. 100% our own — no dependency on any third-party Busy connector.

entries.title: CA Corner — Bank & Investor Reports False 'No FY data' Error
entries.desc: Preview now correctly detects every FY present in Tally sales_vouchers (derived from voucher_date range instead of a non-existent scalar 'fy' field). Historicals also pull real per-FY sales/purchases via total_amount.

entries.title: Analytics — Sales Frequency Readability
entries.desc: Increased row height and padding on the Sales Frequency table so item names, top customers and totals no longer feel cramped.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.3.1
entries.desc: pyodbc bundled + Busy DB password fallback chain (Busy 21/18/older) + BUSY_DB_PASSWORD override field in Settings.

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.30 — Forward-Dated Voucher Fix
entries.desc: Quick-sync window now extends to today, not stops at stored LVD. Reconcile is date-scoped — prevents mass deletions when a voucher is added with a future date.

entries.title: Busy Sync Agent v1.2 — Full Tally Parity

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.29 — LVD & AlterID Persist

entries.title: Marketing Kit

entries.title: Inventory Export Bugs

entries.title: Beat Run — Mandatory Order/Payment + Close Day

entries.title: Salesman Copy-From

entries.title: Tally Agent v9.8.28 — SVCurrentCompany Fix
entries.desc: Fixed XML header format that some Tally builds rejected. Zero errors on 5,000+ voucher syncs after fix.

entries.title: Tally Invoice Drift Detection

entries.title: SPIP — 12-Month Rolling Window
